title: Don̈Ana trip
text: A really great day. Sergio was an excellent and very knowledgeable guide. We got to see loads of interesting birds in the rice fields and lots of deer in the woodlands. The walk through the dunes was also interesting. Thoroughly recommend this small group tour.
author: robinpR6824OV

title: Experience nature at it’s best
text: A chance to experience natural landscapes and wildlife. This is a small group tour in a 4 wheel drive van. There were only 6 of us and we had a wonderful day out with Sergio - our driver guide. Sergio has an amazing knowledge of this environment- both the birds and wildlife and the landscape. We visited El Rocio - a really interesting town where horses are part of everyday life. We enjoyed a nice relaxing lunch at El Flamenco on the foreshore at Matalascañas Beach. author: E4465YImichelleh

title: Doñana and El Rocio Tour
text: Excellent trip and guide very informative and felt quite relaxed whilst being introduced to the area and the national park. The best ending for our trip to Spain this year.
author: davidfD7691JA

title: Great tour of Spain's Natural beauty.
text: We were the only English speaking guests and it was super fun to hear first in Spanish and then a translation. It was also just so nice to see different tundras of Spain: bog, forest, Savannah, and the coast. So glad we got to go on this experience.
author: lindsayt954

title: Thank you Jose
text: Jose, our guide was exceptional! We went for the wildlife and he is clearly a birdwatching enthusiast.  Knowing where to spot them and faultlessly identify them. He is also hugely knowledgeable about the history of the area, the plants and conservation. His English is amazing.
author: CCJH2016

title: Excursion through the northern area of Doñana with a very nice guide.
text:
The excursion is worth it, I went with my daughter to the northern area of Doñana. Luismi the guide is very professional, dedicated to his work and nature, he does it with enthusiasm and pleasure and is always attentive to what you need, I loved the car ride through Doñana and the walking route. 
The trip was very enjoyable and we had an incredible day.
I recommend that excursion and the guide who was also our driver 100%, we had a lot of fun.
author: gorepiya

title: A good Nature Trip.
text: There were 4 of us in a 4×4 . Luis was driver and guide. He gave us a lot of history. We saw the rice daddies, flamingos, storks and other birds. Enjoyed El Rocio. Walking in the forest of the huge Doñana National Park. All in all I would recommend.
author: sandraw881

title: Superb discovery of Doñana Park.
text:
We spent 2 beautiful days visiting Doñana Park and Matalascañas. Our guide Sergio was very kind with a lot of knowledge about the park's flora and fauna. We even saw a lynx. It was incredible! 
We also went horseback riding in El Rocio with Javier and Rocio. We loved it. The village is magnificent and worth the detour. We were well accompanied from the beginning to the end of our stay. 
Thanks to the Naturanda team.
author: asleb2025

title: Fantastic tour
text: ​Such a fantastic tour! Doñana National Park is beautiful. Our guide Jose was excellent, highly knowledgeable and packed with great information about the area. Matalascañas Beach was  stunning and water was warm enough for a swim. Highly recommended.
author: Relax23044023128

title: Excellent organization and the guides are very helpful and friendly.
text: Excellent experience overall. Great organization and the guides are excellent and friendly.
